# Build your customer growth engine with agents

## Get started

- [Getting startedLearn how to authenticate and make your first calls to the Klaviyo API.](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/get_started)
- [Set up your AI agentConnect your AI agent to Klaviyo's docs, OpenAPI spec, MCP server and CLI.](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/agent_setup)
- [Developer guidesDetailed guides for common integrations and use cases.](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs)
- [API referenceEvery endpoint, with its parameters, request and response bodies, and an example request.](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference)

## Developer tools

- [Web and Mobile SDKsKlaviyo offers SDKs for server-side languages (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter).](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/sdk_overview)
- [Klaviyo MCP serverGet AI assistance with your Klaviyo data using Klaviyo's MCP server.](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/klaviyo_mcp_server)
- [Klaviyo CLICall every Klaviyo API operation as a typed command from your terminal, to build, test and script your integration, or to give an AI agent the API.](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/klaviyo_cli)
- [Create a test accountLearn how to create a sandbox account that is linked to your production account login. Test your code end-to-end.](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/create_a_test_account)
- [Use Klaviyo's Postman collectionsLearn how to use our Postman collections to get started with Klaviyo's APIs](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/use_klaviyos_postman_collections)
- [Generate sample dataLearn how to use the Sample Data Generation Tool to populate your Klaviyo account with three types of sample data: Klaviyo, custom ecommerce integration, and catalog data.](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/generate_sample_data)

## Building with an AI agent?

Every page has a Markdown version: add `.md` to the end of its URL. [llms.txt](https://developers.klaviyo.com/llms.txt) indexes the reference by resource, [llms-full.txt](https://developers.klaviyo.com/llms-full.txt) holds every endpoint page in one file, and you can download the [OpenAPI spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/2026-10-15/openapi/stable.json) the reference is generated from.

### Connect your agent to Klaviyo

Klaviyo's MCP server lets an agent work with the data in a Klaviyo account. Add the remote server at `https://mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp` to your MCP client. In Claude Code, run this command:

```
claude mcp add --transport http klaviyo https://mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp
```

[Set up the MCP server in another client](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/connect_to_the_klaviyo_mcp_server)

### Agent skills

Agent skills are step-by-step instructions that an AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex follows to build on the Klaviyo API. Each one is a short SKILL.md that links to the reference and code files it needs, all in Markdown. Point your agent at the one that fits what you're building.

[Build with an AI agent](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/agents)
